annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 234/23
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision designating expert panels in medical devices under Regulation 2017/745. It sets rules on appointing advisors, a central expert list, coordination committee, secretariat, conflict-of-interest declarations, transparency and remuneration. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designates eleven expert panels by clinical area plus one additional panel
Advisors appointed via public call, three-year terms, with a central list of experts
Coordination committee adopts common rules of procedure, reviewed every three years
Strict independence and conflict-of-interest declarations; public disclosure of names, declarations and opinions
Advisors remunerated at 450 EUR per day with capped working days
